text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Don't flatter yourself. You've got no 
reason to apologize to me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"An injury like this is no big deal. I'm 
going back to training."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Since when did you turn into a 
mongrel that bites the hand that feeds it?
choice_data_list: I can't let you push yourself any further!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Tch, acting awful bold today, aren't we? A 
bad dog needs to be disciplined—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I'm the one who left an opening 
for her to strike."

Sirius Symboli rested her body and 
properly received treatment.

I doubt she'd listen even if I said 
something. I'll follow Sirius Symboli's 
wishes for now, making sure to support her 
so she doesn't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Good that you're sensible. Fine then. Come 
on, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I was the one who started this. I will 
take the blame and bear the 
responsibility.

Sirius Symboli went home alone. I felt 
pathetic for not even being able to offer 
her some support.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
See? If it's just light exercise, it's not 
a problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I know the condition of my own body. You 
just shut up and watch from over there.

Exercising within a safe limit, the goal 
was to make a smooth return to training!
